eval_metrics.description: Skill fetches all accounts and holdings correctly via get_accounts and get_positions
Skill correctly interprets '1 day', 'this week', 'past month', etc.
Skill correctly filters for stocks, crypto, or both as requested
If user has multiple accounts, separate tables are shown for each account
Gainers are sorted descending by % change; losers sorted ascending, within each account
Position value = current price × quantity held, calculated correctly
Output is presented as readable Markdown tables with proper labeling per account
Price, % change, dollar change, and position values are accurate and consistent with holdings
